The structure of Mg14Fe2Sb2 (reduced formula Mg7FeSb) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 18 atoms in the unit cell distributed over 8 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for Fe, Mg, and Sb centers, each with 12 geometric neighbors; one Mg orbit is recognized as an 11-vertex coordination polyhedron. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connects all 18 sites, and validated polyhedron-sharing contacts include corner- and edge-sharing between 12-vertex Mg and 11-vertex Mg polyhedra, plus corner-sharing between 12-vertex Mg and Fe polyhedra.
